Meta.title: Watchlist
Meta.description: Your personal movie and series watchlist: track what to watch, what you are watching and what you have seen, with data from TMDB.

Footer.tmdb: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Data and images from <link>The Movie Database (TMDB)</link>.

Home.title: What to watch next
Home.intro: Browse what is trending, popular and top rated, then save titles to your watchlist.

Search.title: Search
Search.label: Search TMDB
Search.placeholder: Title or name, for example Dune
Search.resultCount: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} for “{query}”, showing {shown}.
Search.emptyDescription: Results appear as you type. Switch between all results, movies, series and people.
Search.noResultsDescription: We could not find anything for “{query}”. Check the spelling or try another word.

Providers.title: Where to watch
Providers.none: {title} is not available to stream, rent or buy in this region right now.

Watchlist.title: My watchlist
Watchlist.intro: Everything you saved, stored only in this browser.
Watchlist.notePlaceholder: Who recommended it, where to watch, anything
Watchlist.notPersisted: Your browser is blocking storage, so changes will be lost when you close this tab.
Watchlist.emptyDescription: Save movies and series from search or any detail page. You can also import a list you exported earlier.
Watchlist.showing: Showing {shown} of {total, plural, one {# title} other {# titles}}.

Stats.title: Statistics
Stats.estimate: Estimated where the length is unknown

ImportExport.title: Back up or move your list
ImportExport.description: Export a JSON file, then import it in another browser. Imported titles replace saved ones with the same title.
ImportExport.imported: Imported {count, plural, one {# title} other {# titles}}{skipped, plural, =0 {.} one {, skipped # invalid entry.} other {, skipped # invalid entries.}}
ImportExport.invalid: That file is not a watchlist export.
ImportExport.tooLarge: That file is too large to be a watchlist export.

Share.title: Share a read only link
Share.description: The list is packed into the link itself and nothing is uploaded. The link shows the list as it is when you copy it.
Share.truncated: Only the first {max} titles fit in a link.
Share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.

Shared.intro: A read only list someone shared with you.
Shared.invalidDescription: The shared list is missing or damaged. Ask for a new link.
Shared.addAll: {count, plural, =0 {Already in your watchlist} one {Add # title to my watchlist} other {Add # titles to my watchlist}}
Shared.added: {count, plural, one {Added # title} other {Added # titles}} to your watchlist.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.regionHint: Streaming, rent and buy offers on detail pages are shown for this region.
Settings.languageHint: Used for the interface and, where TMDB has a translation, for titles and overviews.

Errors.pageMessage: We could not load this page. Please try again.
Errors.rowMessage: The movie database did not respond. Reload the page to try again.
Errors.searchMessage: The movie database did not respond. Check your connection and try again.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: This page does not exist, or the title was removed from TMDB.
